pillars.label: The method
pillars.heading: Four things a business presence has to do.
pillars.lead: One of them is our product today. Two are foundations we prepare. One is where we are going. We say which is which, on the page.

build.title: Build
build.body: Premium Done-For-You websites and digital business presence: multilingual implementation, SEO foundations, conversion architecture, analytics readiness, and clean code you own outright. This is what ZOHAR sells today.

grow.title: Grow
grow.body: We build growth-ready foundations — structure for search and for AI answers, speed, and a clear conversion path — and we support growth with human work, not software.
grow.note: There is no automated Growth Engine today. The productised Growth Engine is roadmap V13.

prove.title: Prove
prove.body: We prepare analytics, attribution and measurement foundations, and configure them properly where the accounts and access exist. You get a site that is ready to be measured.
prove.note: There is no finished Proof product today. The integrated Connect + Measure layer is roadmap V12.

memory.title: Memory
memory.body: Persistent business memory, and controlled business agents that act on it, are our long-term direction.
memory.note: This does not exist today, we do not sell it, and nothing on this site depends on it. Roadmap V14.

process.label: How it works
process.heading: From a sentence to a live presence.
process.s1b: You describe the business in your own words. We ask the questions that matter.
process.s2b: We agree the structure, the message and the look before anything is built.
process.s3b: We design and write it, then build it in clean code you will own.
process.s4b: You preview it, we correct it, and it goes live on your own domain.

trust.label: Ownership
trust.heading: What you get to keep.
trust.t1: You own the code, outright, from day one.
trust.b1: No page builder, no theme, no licence that expires.
trust.b2: The site is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Any developer can continue it.
trust.b3: Right-to-left is built in, not bolted on. This site is the proof.
trust.b4: Canonical structure, hreflang, structured data and clean markup from the start.
trust.b5: Analytics and attribution are prepared, and configured where you have the accounts.
trust.b6: You see the site before it launches, and you approve what goes live.

faq.label: Questions
faq.heading: Straight answers.
faq.q1: How long does a ZOHAR website take to build?
faq.a1: A marketing site is typically 3 to 7 working days once the brief is agreed and the content is with us. Stores and systems are quoted individually, with the timeline set before work starts.
faq.q2: What exactly do I own at the end?
faq.a2: The full source: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images and configuration. You can host it anywhere and any developer can continue it. There is no licence to renew and no platform to stay on.
faq.q3: Can I edit the site myself afterwards?
faq.a3: Text and image changes are handled by us as part of your plan today. A self-service editor is in development and is not available yet.
faq.q4: Do you work in languages other than Hebrew and English?
faq.a4: Yes. Multilingual implementation is part of the service, and right-to-left languages are handled properly rather than mirrored as an afterthought.
faq.q5: Can you move my existing WordPress site?
faq.a5: Where it is genuinely deliverable, yes — we rebuild the content in owned code rather than migrating the plugins. We will tell you honestly if your site is a poor fit.
faq.a6: No. We build the structure that makes results possible and we prepare the measurement that shows whether they happened. Anyone guaranteeing a number before seeing your market is guessing.
faq.a7: A Done-For-You marketing site starts at ₪2,800. Stores, systems and migrations are quoted after the brief, so the number you get is the number you pay.
faq.a8: Not yet. It is in development. Today every ZOHAR website is created through the Done For You process, and we do not take payment for anything that is not ready.

brief.label: Start here
brief.heading: Tell us what your business does.
brief.lead: One sentence is enough to begin. Five short questions, about two minutes.
brief.placeholder: We’re a family winery in the Galilee, and we sell direct to visitors and to restaurants…
brief.privacy: We would use your answers only to prepare a proposal for you. We do not sell or share them, and you can ask us to delete them at any time.
brief.disabled: Submissions are not enabled yet. The endpoint and privacy handling are pending approval, so nothing is transmitted or stored.
brief.errEmpty: Please tell us a little about the business before continuing.
brief.errShort: A sentence or two would help — please add a bit more detail.
